purpose: Wave-4 Thieving / Hunter / Farming permanent unlocks and region-defining patch/minigame packages still missing as first-class rows. Covers Pyramid Plunder infrastructure (not black-ibis re-row), Vault of Hereditas + Asuran Arsenal heists, Asgarnia safecracking circuit, hops/bush/fruit-tree/herb patch networks, HAM hideout, Puro-Puro dragon implings, Keldagrim dwarven traders, Big Chinchompa private grounds, enhanced yaktwee stick, POF breeding-log tier-1 perks, crystal skillchompas, harmony pillars, Wilderness herb patch, Het's Oasis farming + Dundee crocodile upgrades, calquat, and juju farming path. Complements regional desert/kandarin/karamja packs and training-gap-thieving without re-emitting desert:pyramid-plunder-black-ibis or desert:hets-oasis-prayer-powders as duplicates.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields as sole region_hint except cross-region:* packages that intentionally span.
policy.duplicate_guard: SKIP separate desert:sceptre-of-the-gods / pharaoh's-sceptre equipment row — sceptre acquisition + SotG charge caps already live under desert:pyramid-plunder-black-ibis notes and desert:area-tasks-desert-amulet (SotG caps / recharge). Use desert:pyramid-plunder once as the minigame infrastructure package; link black-ibis row. Do not re-emit desert:hets-oasis-prayer-powders, desert:kharid-et-dig-site heist footnote as full heist, kandarin:skillchompa-supply (generic), karamja:herblore-habitat / juju-potions-pointer, asgarnia:trollheim-disease-free-herb-patch, forinthry:area-tasks-wilderness-sword (sword effects only — this file adds wilderness-herb-patch site row).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks, patch networks, and region-defining Thieving/Hunter/Farming infrastructure that change self-sufficient progression.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, effects, and gates only. Training rates stay in training-gap-thieving / training-methods.
